question.text: The pulley shown in figure is made using a thin rim and two rods of length equal to diameter of the rim. The rim and each rod have a mass of $M$. Two blocks of mass of $M$ and $m$ are attached to two ends of a light string passing over the pulley, which is hinged to rotate freely in vertical plane about its center. The magnitudes of the acceleration experienced by the blocks is $\_\_\_\_$ (assume no slipping of string on pulley).
